title: Where Stillness Begins, Binaural Meditation
scene: Concentric ripples settling around a single quiet ember
description: A slow binaural meditation built on warm, sustained tones that drift gently between the ears. The beat settles into a calm, unhurried pulse with soft textures underneath, made for long sits and quiet breathing. Best on headphones.

title: Moss After Rain, Forest Rain and Stream for Sleep
scene: Soft rain on moss beside a small forest stream
description: Steady rain on leaves, a small stream, and a few distant birds, over a low, warm drone. A very subtle slow pulse sits underneath to help the mind settle. Mixed for speakers and made to fade into the background for a full night's sleep.

title: The Uncarved Way, Cosmic Drone Meditation
scene: Ember dust drifting in a slow spiral through dark space
description: A deep, slowly evolving cosmic drone with a low fundamental and soft shimmering partials. Nothing hurries and nothing interrupts; it is simply a wide, steady space to rest attention in. Works on speakers or headphones.

title: Where the Ember Sleeps — Deep Delta Sleep Tones
scene: Embers at night by a dark sea
description: A binaural beat that glides from 6 Hz theta down to 2 Hz delta over the first fifteen minutes, then holds there. It rests on a dark, warm just-intonation pad around 110 Hz with a soft 55 Hz undertone, slow ocean swells, and distant rain. There are no sudden or bright sounds; best on headphones.

title: Clear Water Mind — 40 Hz Focus with Brown Noise
description: A steady 40 Hz gamma binaural beat under soft brown noise and a neutral drone built from open fifths and fourths. The chords change only every few minutes, and the level stays even from start to finish, with no melody to pull your attention. Best on headphones.

title: Tin Roof, Slow Rain — Rain for Sleep and Calm
scene: Rain on a tin roof, thunder far away
description: Slow rain ringing on a tin roof, with gentle thunder rolling far off every few minutes. A soft low pad in D drifts underneath with a barely-there 4 Hz pulse, mixed for a pair of speakers.

title: Low Ember Hum — Warm Brown Noise
scene: A warm hum in a dark room
description: Warm, low-passed brown noise drifting gently between the speakers. Under it sits a subtle harmonic drone on C whose overtones change slowly, so the bass stays round even on small speakers.

title: Cabin Fire, First Snow — Cozy Fireside Ambience
scene: A crackling fire in a cabin as the first snow falls
description: A crackling fireplace with a low roar, soft wind and snow outside the window, and an occasional creak of old wood. A gentle, warm pad in F holds the room together, with a faint slow pulse beneath it.
